entry.title: SHRINCS: an efficient hash-based signature scheme for Bitcoin (first draft)
entry.summary:
The discussion highlights a concern regarding the potential format change for Bitcoin Improvement Proposals (BIPs). The primary issue addressed is the use of GitHub-flavored Markdown and the implications if BIPs were to be transferred to a different platform. The compatibility features specific to GitHub's Markdown could potentially become problematic if moved, thereby affecting the document's layout and readability.
Moreover, there's an acknowledgment of the decreasing costs associated with amending such formatting issues in documents. This reduction in cost lessens the burden of maintaining or altering document formats, making it more feasible to stick with Markdown rather than transitioning to another format. Consequently, the suggestion has been made to continue submitting documents in Markdown format unless there are other compelling reasons for a change. This recommendation supports maintaining consistency and stability in document management within the Bitcoin development community.
